materials.name: 涂层弹体与翼面（等效表面）
materials.description: 可见光模型的涂装壳体及翼面；黑色色带、标识和铆钉不误判为裸金属。

parameterEvidence.status: generic engineering estimate; NOT measured HJ-10 properties
parameterEvidence.spectrumModel: gray equivalent, constant emissivity; not a measured spectral curve
parameterEvidence.uncertainty: surface finish, coating and oxidation unknown; use only for visual simulation
parameterEvidence.visibleBandCaveat: 0.38-2 um entries only extend the renderer LUT; not measured visible optical constants

materials.description: 尾端环面和喷口近口表面；仅作通用耐热表面类比，不代表型号实测材料。

parameterEvidence.status: generic engineering estimate; NOT measured HJ-10 properties
parameterEvidence.spectrumModel: gray equivalent, constant emissivity; not a measured spectral curve

limitations: 不是实测温度/光谱，也不是CFD或武器性能模型。
尾焰/喷流不包含在表面MCM中。
光谱为明确标注的灰体等效，不将总发射率伪装成测量光谱。
